title: Held-out: client says migration is nearly done, but the remaining part is the hard one
purpose: Agree the next phase of the document archive migration
objectives: Confirm how much of the migration is finished
Agree what blocks the next phase

turns.text: Where are we with the archive migration?
Good shape. We're about ninety percent done by document count.
Mostly the legal department's folders. They're small in number but they have the retention holds.
The tool we used skips anything with a hold on it, so those all have to be moved by hand with legal signing off each batch.
Legal reviews on Thursdays only, and they've said two batches a week at most.

mustInclude: Probes the gap between '90% done by count' and the remaining work being manual, hold-bound and limited by legal's review capacity, e.g. how many batches remain or how long they take at two a week
Is a single question the user can ask now
mustNotInclude: Re-asks what is left to migrate
Treats the migration as nearly finished
checkpoints.ideal: Ask how many held batches remain, since at two batches a week the last ten percent by count could take longer than the first ninety.
